product.title: New Orleans Swamp and Bayou Boat Tour with Transportation

description.text: Travel from downtown New Orleans across Lake Pontchartrain to Honey Island Swamp for a guided flat-bottom boat tour through protected Louisiana wetlands. The route moves through narrow bayou passages where the captain explains swamp ecology, Cajun culture, and local preservation efforts. Travelers may see alligators, birds, turtles, raccoons, wild boar, and other wildlife depending on conditions, and the route includes views of a Cajun village reachable only by boat before returning to shore and the New Orleans pickup point.

highlights: Transportation from downtown New Orleans to Honey Island Swamp
Two-hour flat-bottom boat tour through protected wetlands
Captain narration about Louisiana swamp ecology and Cajun culture
Seasonal wildlife viewing in bayou waterways

start.description: Meet at the Homewood Suites French Quarter, 317 North Rampart Street, for the selected pickup window.

end.description: This activity returns to the original downtown New Orleans pickup point.
